fixtures.description: The prose roadmap every positive sidecar links to; legacy-parseable, untouched by the contract.
Positive all-fields sidecar: one routine ready slice, one live corrective attempt-002 slice.
The same live corrective entry at attempt 001: one attempt identity per entry.
Canonical rendering of the routine slice: no conditional section, no attempt or dispatch-authority residue beyond the entry's values.
Canonical rendering of the attempt-001 entry from its own sidecar; paths and output root resolve to 001 only.
Canonical rendering of the live corrective entry at attempt 002: every conditional section, every leaf, resolved attempt paths and output root.
Unknown artifact types are refused.
Attempt identities run from 001 to 999.
Attempt identities are three zero-padded digits as strings.
At most one attempt token per path.
An attempt token is allowed only with create_fresh_per_attempt.
Candidate identity paths are exact file paths.
Under v1 the coder may not own the review prompt.
The coder may never own a review report.
The coder may never own a verdict record.
The controlling ruling must be an exact repository-relative record path.
Correction closure proof must be non-empty.
Every correction field is required.
claims_withdrawn is 'none' or a non-empty list.
A correction block on a non-corrective slice is invalid.
Corrective slices require an attempt identity; the attempt-qualified output root then has no attempt to bind to.
A corrective slice requires a correction block.
A corrective slice must name its controlling findings.
A corrective slice must name the controlling ruling or the dispute record.
A dispatch authority must be an exact repository-relative record path.
The same slice id is declared twice.
non_goals must be non-empty.
A binding hash is 64 lowercase hex digits.
A binding may carry only a name and a value hash, never the value.
Unknown cleanup values are refused.
Unknown result-handling values are refused.
An envelope without a hard wall is incomplete.
Walls and budgets are positive numbers.
The timing probe needs a command and expected seconds.
An envelope on a non-live slice is invalid.
An external input path must be an exact relative file path.
An external input requires repository, path, role, identity.
Every finding carries its coder obligation.
create_fresh_per_attempt needs exactly one attempt token in the path.
Rendering of a frozen entry: no dispatch_authority line.
A frozen entry validates without a dispatch authority and is not current work.
A frozen-override authority must be an exact repository-relative record path.
An artifact_identity gate requires its sha256.
Unknown gate kinds are refused.
A path-kind gate reference must be an exact repository-relative path.
A gate requires a reference.
A reserved review-report path cannot be relabelled governance_record to bypass the role fence.
An empty title is invalid.
A prose roadmap with no sidecar is legacy; nothing about it changes.
A live slice must carry a complete execution envelope.
A root that escapes local_state/ after normalization is invalid.
Live outputs must land under the local-state root.
An attempt-bearing entry needs its attempt token in the output root.
The objective block is absent.
Objective needs non-empty success criteria and closure proof.
Old-consumer fence fixture component; evaluated against the released legacy consumer.
Old-consumer fence fixture component; evaluated against the released legacy consumer.
Old-consumer fence fixture component; evaluated against the released legacy consumer.

Old-consumer fence fixture component; evaluated against the released legacy consumer.
Prior evidence paths are exact repository-relative paths.
Two projections declaring identical entries align.
The active-projection sidecar used by the alignment fixtures; valid on its own.
A slice declared in only one projection fails closed.
Same slice id with a differing entry across projections fails closed.
Projections declaring different contract versions fail closed.
read_first entries are exact repository-relative paths.
A ready entry must record its dispatch authority.
Confirming a different attempt than the entry declares is refused; an entry has one attempt identity.
An attempt-002 prompt whose paths resolve to attempt 001 everywhere reuses history, carries undeclared rows and path, and no longer equals its entry.
A not-applicable section survived with its marker.
A prose envelope value differs while the typed entry is exact; prose is not the carrier.
A prose list carries an extra item while the typed entry is exact; prose is not the carrier.

Round-2 probe under the carrier method: a prose value differs while the typed entry is exact. Prose values are not conformance-checked (contract section 8); the typed entry is the carrier, so this renders as a renderer-quality defect, not a contract violation.
A single prose manifest cell differs from the entry: the declared row is missing and the altered row is undeclared.
A declared row repeated: the second occurrence is undeclared.
Round-4 probe R4-F2: a well-formed row for a path the entry does not declare; the table is write authority and is exact by cardinality.
Workflow metadata says frozen while the entry is ready.
Workflow metadata says ready while the typed entry and the sidecar say frozen.
A write-manifest row was lost in the prose table.
A section appears twice.
A required section heading is missing.
Two required sections swapped.
Round-5 probe R5-F1: the exact declared Self-Report line repeated; cardinality is a singleton, so the second occurrence is undeclared.
The Self-Report section names a different path than the manifest's self-report row: the declared line is missing and the other is undeclared.
A second backticked path line in Self-Report is undeclared authority.
A slot token survived rendering in the prose.
The attempt token survived into the rendered prompt and its typed entry.
The Typed Entry section is absent; the status is then declared once only.
A value inside the typed entry differs from the sidecar entry; the prose still says Level 3.
The section exists but carries no fenced yaml block; the status is then declared once only.
Two fenced yaml blocks in the Typed Entry section are ambiguous.
Round-4 probe R4-F3: the exact Typed Entry section moved from last to first; the mapping is intact but the layout order is violated.
A leaf was dropped from the typed entry while the prose still lists it.
The typed entry carries a key the sidecar entry does not declare.
The typed entry block does not parse as strict YAML.
Flow-style typed entry: the mapping equals, but no line-start status line exists in the carrier and the metadata says ready.
Round-4 probe R4-F1: metadata ready, typed status quoted. The mapping still equals the frozen entry; the status line must be plain and must agree.
Tagged-scalar status spelling with opposite metadata.
Unknown retry policies are refused.
Under v1 the review prompt may be owned by architect_reviewer.
Under v1 the review prompt may be owned by human_owner.
Under v1 the review prompt may be owned by reviewer.
Under v1 the review prompt may be owned by runner.
The closure record must precede the verdict.
Two closure headings are ambiguous.
A review report without the closure record.
The evidence line must immediately follow the status line.
A section between the closure record and the verdict is invalid.
The closure section holds exactly two non-empty lines.
Exact closure record immediately before the unchanged verdict footer; pass with not_achieved is a legal receipt.
An objective-evidence line outside the closure section is not authority and is not counted.

The round-3 probe: an invalid backtick-info opener, duplicate status/evidence lines, then a real fence. Under the section-local rule those lines are not authority and the record is read from the closure section alone.
Heading lines are counted line-start regardless of fences: never quote the closure or verdict heading line inside an example (contract section 9).
A fence indented by up to three spaces is still a fence.
A four-backtick fence closes only on a fence at least as long; the inner three-backtick line does not close it.
An objective-status line outside the closure section is not authority and is not counted (section-local rule).
An objective line inside the verdict section is invalid.
Unknown objective status values are refused.
The status line must use the exact label.
The reviewer's round-2 probe: a tilde-fenced example holding both lines is fenced text and never counts toward cardinality.
Two verdict sections are ambiguous.
An em dash in the verdict footer is rejected.
A review report without a verdict section.
The roadmap link must resolve to a file beside the sidecar.
The roadmap link must be a bare file name beside the sidecar.
Unknown role owners are refused.
Exactly one coder-owned self-report write is required.
An unresolved <value> sentinel in non-goals is a hard error.
An unresolved TBD in the task is a hard error.
A coder seat may not author a sidecar entry.
A runner may not author a sidecar entry.
The sidecar top level must be a mapping.
Slice ids look like M001-S01.
A slice must belong to its declared milestone.
Every slice entry must be a mapping.
slices must be a non-empty list.
Entry status is frozen or ready.
Strictness is Level 1 to Level 4.
A task that merely repeats the title is not a specification.
Contract version 2 is not supported by this template.
The contract version key is absent.
An absolute path is never a repository path.
A directory path grants no write authority.
An empty write path grants nothing.
A parent-traversal path escapes the repository.
A glob grants no write authority.
A write path names a file, not a bare directory-like name.
A create_once path cannot also be a required reading.
